preview: Sarah: You're welcome, Trent. Take care.

messages.text: Hi about the harlo loto. I am not a fan of the green stand. When i early bird it was black. can i get a black base for it ? Or is that to hard ?
Handed to the team · Colour option for an unreleased product; not in the catalog, needs a person to d

Fair question, Trent. The Loto isn't in the store yet, so I can't see any colour options for it, and I don't want to promise you a black base I can't check.

I've asked the team whether you can have the black base you saw when you put your early-bird deposit down (Shop····). Someone will pick it up and email you the answer.
Do you know how long for the email ?
Usually within one business day, Trent. The team is in right now, so it may come sooner, but I can't promise exactly when. It'll go to the email you used for this chat.
Before you go, one thing: what is it about the green stand that doesn't work for you? Is it where the Loto will sit, or just not your style?
Both everything else i have is black i was going to put it next to my gaming pc and my harlo b30
That makes sense, a matching black setup next to your PC and B30. Was the black look part of why you put the early-bird deposit down in the first place?
Yea looks really good in the black
Thanks, Trent, that's really helpful to know. The team will email you about the black base.
